node.statement: Fix an arbitrary H-CB datum satisfying the hypotheses of node 1 and an arbitrary n >= 1, and write T := Ha^Q_{P,P}. Because T is bijective at level one, its matrix amplification T_n is bijective: by the meaning of amplification, T_n([Z_ij])=[T(Z_ij)]; hence for any target matrix [Y_ij], the matrix [T^(-1)(Y_ij)] is a preimage, while T_n([Z_ij])=0 implies T(Z_ij)=0 for every i,j and therefore Z_ij=0 for every i,j. Thus (T_n)^(-1) is the entrywise amplification of T^(-1).
